$comment: The owner's listing-photo plan for the PNGTuber cosy desk props (legacy make-listing-photos.mjs, owner 2026-10-17, ported word for word at the 5th port moment). Read by src/engine/owner.mjs makeListingPhotos and scripts/parity-pngtuber.mjs. Scene units are free (centre x, baseline, height; later entries are drawn in front).
ownerWords: Make clean Etsy listing photos, $0, no model or image-generation calls (deterministic compositing of the 12 approved PNGs only). 01-hero: all 12 props in a tidy grid on a soft warm background, 3000x2250 (4:3), nothing cropped at the edges. 02-on-dark: the same grid on a dark background, to show the transparency. 03-scene: the props arranged together as one cozy desk scene on a plain background, showing how they look in use. 04 to 07: close-ups of 4 props (mug, cat on cushion, candle, headphones), each 2000x2000. No text on the images, no QA labels, no watermarks. Correction: don't touch the approved package or its MANIFEST.json; save the listing photos in work/<id>/listing-photos/ with a small photos.json listing each file's sha256. They're for the Etsy page only, not the buyer download.
